credits.title: Credits
credits.intro: The spoken audio in Hablas is machine generated. It is made in advance with the voices below and played back as pre-rendered clips.
credits.restrictionsHeading: What the licence does not allow
credits.restrictionsIntro: These use-based restrictions come with the voice licence and apply to the voice model and its output. Please respect them.

restrictions.law: In any way that violates any applicable law or regulation.
restrictions.minors: To exploit or harm minors, or attempt to.
restrictions.disinformation: To generate or spread verifiably false information in order to harm others.
restrictions.pii: To generate or spread personal information that can be used to harm an individual.
restrictions.machine_generated: To place generated content in any context without clearly saying it is machine generated.
restrictions.harassment: To defame, disparage or harass others.
restrictions.impersonation: To impersonate others without their consent, for example with deepfakes.
restrictions.automated_decisions: For fully automated decisions that adversely affect the legal rights of a person or create or modify a binding, enforceable obligation.
restrictions.social_discrimination: To discriminate against or harm people based on online or offline social behaviour or personal characteristics.
restrictions.vulnerable_groups: To exploit the vulnerabilities of a group of people, based on age or social, physical or mental characteristics, in order to materially distort their behaviour in a way that is likely to cause physical or psychological harm.
restrictions.protected_discrimination: To discriminate against people based on legally protected characteristics.
restrictions.medical: To give medical advice or interpret medical results.
restrictions.justice: To generate or spread information meant for administration of justice, law enforcement, immigration or asylum processes.
